instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Switch Do Not Disturb on the person's computer on or off", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:focus and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: on true turns Focus on, false turns it off.
